in_marathi.name: Balbeer
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Brave and Strong
in_marathi.long_meaning: Balbeer हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Balbeer is a compound name derived from Sanskrit. 'Bal' means strength and 'Beer' means fearless or brave. In Hindu mythology, Balbeer is a name associated with the god Hanuman, who embodies strength, courage, and devotion.
